_notes: Data layer for the MetaHuman Dracula head integration (read by Assets/Editor/MHIntegrate.cs at integration time and by Assets/MetaHumanHead/Scripts/Game/MHHeadAttach.cs + MHHeadLod.cs at runtime).

BuildPlayer.cs copies this file to StreamingAssets, so the player reads the same values. Tune here, no code or scene change needed (except fighterName/boneNames/builder, which are applied by re-running MHIntegrate.Run).

attach.localPosition is metres, in the head-bone frame as it is at the character's rest pose (x right, y up, z forward); it is an EXTRA offset on top of the automatic alignment of the MetaHuman 'alignJoint' to the body head bone.

attach.localEuler is degrees, applied in the same rest frame (0,0,0 = MetaHuman face looks along the character's forward). attach.localScale is the WORLD size multiplier of the head (1 = metric MetaHuman size); with compensateParentScale the bone's lossy scale is divided out.

lod.switchDistancesM = [lod0Max, lod1Max] in metres from the game camera to the head: below the first value LOD0 (0 = LOD0 never used; close-up cutscenes only), below the second LOD1, else LOD2. Game camera is 4-6 m, README: LOD1 up to 4 m, LOD2 beyond. hysteresisM prevents flicker at a threshold.
